claims.text: Vendor reports one cooling unit consistently warmer than the other.
claims.quote:
That unit consistently operated
7.2°F
warmer than the other unit, with no overlap in temperature ranges.
claims.scope_note: Relative temperature only, no physical adjacency established.

claims.text: Vendor reports an autonomous inspection pilot in Houston.
claims.quote: Since July 28, 2026, FacilityOps AI has been conducting an autonomous inspection pilot at the CRSC Data Center, powered by Solutions IS, in Houston, Texas.
claims.scope_note: Vendor self-report. No independent CRSC confirmation.

claims.text: Vendor reports detection of a failed condenser.
claims.quote: The system detected a failed condenser on one of two cooling units.
claims.scope_note: Detection does not establish automatic repair.

claims.text: Vendor reports handheld confirmation of the measurement.
claims.quote:
A handheld verification confirmed the measurement within
1.1°F
.
claims.scope_note: Confirmation within stated tolerance, not exact identity. Narration omits number.

claims.text: Vendor reports repaired condenser and restored normal operation.
claims.quote: The condenser was promptly repaired and the unit has returned to normal operation, reflecting the priority CRSC places on reliability and swift maintenance.
claims.scope_note: Repair actor unspecified. No robot repair or independent maintenance record.

claims.text: Vendor reports intermittent spikes in second cooling unit, flagged but not confirmed faulty.
claims.quote:
The second cooling unit exhibited intermittent temperature spikes of up to
15.5°F
.
While not yet confirmed as a fault, the condition was flagged for inspection.
claims.scope_note: Two verbatim excerpts. No confirmed second failure or repair.

claims.text: Case study specifies findings period and September 23rd update describing ongoing pilot.
claims.quote: Findings cover the period July 28 to August 21, 2026. The pilot at the CRSC Data Center, powered by Solutions IS, is ongoing. Last updated September 23, 2026.
claims.scope_note: July 28 to August 21 findings. Status at September update, not fresh October event.

claims.quote: An autonomous route holds position. Same checkpoint, same angle, every pass.
claims.scope_note: General product description, not pilot hardware or accuracy validation.

rejected.reason: The source compares one unit with the other; adjacency is not established.

rejected.claim: New October detection or repair action
rejected.reason: Findings cover July 28 to August 21; update is September 23.
Both sources are vendor publications, without independent operator statement or maintenance record.

rejected.claim: Measured downtime savings, avoided outage, general accuracy or cost savings
rejected.reason: No controlled validation or measured savings supports these claims.

rejected.claim: Second unit confirmed faulty or repaired
rejected.reason: Source expressly flags condition for inspection without confirmed fault.

rejected.claim: Robot repaired equipment or replaced thermal survey
rejected.reason: Repair actor unspecified; product page explicitly says surveys are not replaced.
